description: Intent i014 (SNAPSHOT=s04, branch=debugfs-write-memdup-sscanf) complete. Two high-confidence findings of the seed's exact mechanism (usercopy of attacker-sized length into an exactly-sized allocation, then C-string parser with no NUL-terminator guarantee): (1) drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c:314-320 — bnad_debugfs_write_regrd, debugfs 'regrd' (fops .write at line 454), kern_buf = memdup_user(buf, nbytes) then rc = sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", &addr, &len); memdup_user is kmalloc(nbytes)+copy_from_user with no terminator slot (mm/util.c), file contains no memdup_user_nul/strndup_user and no cmd_buf[count]='\0', so a non-NUL user write makes sscanf read past the nbytes-sized heap allocation (KASAN slab-OOB read). This is the same Brocade bfa/bnad code family as seed commit 13d0cecb4626; the seed file drivers/scsi/bfa/bfad_debugfs.c itself still shows the bug at lines 253/320 in s04, but per rules it is excluded from reporting. Twin site bnad_debugfs_write_regwr at lines 375-379 (debugfs 'regwr'). (2) drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c:98-102 — crw_inject_write, debugfs 'crw_inject', buffer = vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf) then sscanf(buffer, "%x %x %x %x %x %x %x", ...); vmemdup_user (mm/util.c:236) is kvmalloc(len)+copy_from_user with no NUL slot, no terminator fix-up or clamp anywhere in the file (kvfree only after sscanf), so the scan runs past the lbuf-sized allocation. Both quotes verified to occur literally in the reported line ranges. Additional candidates: drivers/net/netdevsim/fib.c:1384 unresolved (stack char buf[128], guard is 'size > sizeof(buf)' so size==128 fills the array with no terminator slot before sscanf("%u %hu")); ice_debugfs.c:174/260/335/431 classified safe because count is clamped (<=8/4/2/5) before memdup_user though the pattern is otherwise identical (residual theoretical kmalloc-rounding OOB noted); ten other debugfs write sites (octeontx2 rvu_debugfs count+1 slot, scsi_debug kzalloc(count+1), hisilicon/qla2xxx/libertas/hfi1 memdup_user_nul, ath5k/ntb_tool/rt2x00/iwlegacy/amdgpu explicit terminators or memset) rejected as safe with concrete evidence. Bounded limitations: debugfs-root attacker model matching the seed; wireless/drm copy_from_user families triaged in bulk on clamp/terminator evidence rather than deep-read; sysfs/proc/ioctl branches (i015-i017) intentionally not searched; netdevsim stack case left unresolved. Final artifact validated (version 1, snapshots_checked=["s04"], 2 findings, 14 candidates, 5 limitations) at agent-state/findings/i014.json; checkpoint updated to complete.
